title: Kestrel and the Horizon
author: Rafael Ashgrove
blurb: Ulyana Zhou, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
